summary: Backup plans for when content is rejected. When Instagram refuses a post before anything goes out (like "the ig container is not in the status to upload a video"), it starts over with a fresh upload, up to 3 times in the same run, and an approved post that's still refused goes back in the queue for up to 3 hourly runs before it waits for your Try again. When a daily Reel's plan keeps failing on one or two shots, it redoes just those shots instead of dropping the whole Reel.
frontend: An approved post Instagram refused before anything went out stays scheduled, with a note saying which try it was ("try 1 of 3") and when it tries again; only after the third refused run does it show Instagram refused it and the Try again button.
History says when a Reel was refused even after fresh uploads, and that nothing went out.
other: Instagram uploads: a refusal before the publish step starts over with a brand-new container after 30 seconds, then 2 minutes. It never starts over once the publish step was called, or for a refused token or a used-up hourly allowance, so nothing can post twice.
Approved posts: those refusals go back in the queue 50 minutes later, up to 3 runs per approval; Approve or Try again starts the count over. Hitta is told only after the last one.

Daily Reels: when the motion plan still fails after 3 tries and every problem names a shot (a nearly empty drawing, a repeated piece, a made-up number), only those shots are redone. This would have saved the 4 PM explainer on Nov 22 and the 7 AM explainer on Nov 23.
The Facebook Page and YouTube rules don't change: a refusal there is logged and never retried.
